## Objective

Create and verify the reusable init-new-project package from safe destination handling through receipt publication.

## Scope

- Reusable skill package, template allowlist, identity specialization, registry mutation, governed asset adoption, wheel installation, same-run bootstrap, failure recovery

## Entry conditions

- The common bootstrap and immutable artifact workflow pass focused checks.

## Exit criteria

- TASK-007 through TASK-013 pass package, scenario, idempotency, conflict, and rollback checks.

## Risks

- Multi-artifact project creation is vulnerable to partial publication and concurrent registry changes.
- Unfiltered copies could carry private or generated template state.

## TASK-008 - Implement safe destination and template-seed handling

Implement fail-closed destination validation and an explicit template starter allowlist that copies only reviewed project skeleton content and rejects symlinks, traversal, the template itself, the depot root, existing unrelated paths, and out-of-depot destinations.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `completed` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-003, REQ-004, REQ-019, REQ-022, REQ-025 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/init-new-project/scripts/init_new_project.py, SKILLS-depo/init-new-project/assets/template-allowlist.json, SKILLS-depo/init-new-project/tests/test_destination_and_copy.py |
| Dependencies | TASK-007 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | 2026-09-05T03:08:17.656299Z |

### Risks

- The template contains .venv, .ruff_cache, .DS_Store, and generated caches.
- Ancestor or symlink checks can be bypassed if based only on string prefixes.

### Acceptance criteria

- Only allowlisted starter artifacts are copied from Projects/Sys4AI-Template-Project/.
- Transient, derived, environment, cache, bytecode, provider, model, and operating-system files are absent from the result.
- Every forbidden destination is rejected before filesystem or registry mutation.
- The allowlist excludes .git directories, .git gitfiles, .gitmodules and other repository metadata; copying never preserves template Git identity or makes a child part of the parent repository.

### Planned verification

- Run table-driven realpath, symlink, traversal, existing-path, and allowlist tests.
- Compare the created tree with the reviewed allowlist.
- Assert no excluded basename or derived path exists.
- Use disposable preconstructed repository metadata fixtures to prove no .git marker/history is copied; assert no Git mutation command runs.

## TASK-010 - Register factual inventory transactionally

Add the new project to depot/projects.json only after the specialized project exists and passes pre-registration checks, recording observed repository and Pages state and preventing duplicate ID or path entries.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `completed` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-006, REQ-019, REQ-025 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/init-new-project/scripts/init_new_project.py, depot/projects.json, tests/test_repository_contract.py, SKILLS-depo/init-new-project/tests/test_registry.py |
| Dependencies | TASK-009 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | 2026-09-05T03:08:38.237130Z |

### Risks

- Failure between project publish and registry publish could leave partial state.
- Concurrent edits from another discussion must be detected rather than overwritten.

### Acceptance criteria

- The helper rereads and validates the current registry before atomic update.
- One entry records the exact relative path, approved ID, registered true, and only observed external state.
- Equivalent rerun is a no-op and any conflicting ID, path, revision, or content stops without overwrite.
- Repository detection reports initialized only when the Git top-level matches the exact child root. Ancestor-only discovery is reported as missing independent Git state, without creating a repository or inventing a remote.
- The manual route uses this same validated registry operation; neither route registers or modifies an unrelated existing child such as Electronics.

### Planned verification

- Run schema, duplicate, stale-state, and failure-injection tests.
- Compare the registry before and after each scenario.
- Verify no Git repository, remote, Pages, or deployment action occurred.

### Risks

- Environment creation and wheel installation are stateful and need rollback or truthful partial-state reporting.
- Direct provider import outside the adapter can create user-wide logs.

### Acceptance criteria

- One authorized canonical run produces the specialized project, factual registry entry, exact asset copies, installed wheel, project-local Memory System state, and non-secret receipt.
- All preflight checks complete before the first Memory System write, and every Cognee import runs inside the hardened adapter.
- The receipt records actual versions, digests, IDs, paths, checks, outcomes, and any deliberately deferred local model activation, with no preview fields.
- The installed command succeeds as a subprocess without source-checkout PYTHONPATH or injected dispatcher; initialization and provider/model activation are separately reported, and directory creation alone does not count as functional memory.

### Planned verification

- Run the canonical workflow in an isolated fixture workspace.
- Inspect installed distribution metadata and all created paths.
- Validate the receipt schema and assert no preview, credential, user-home, or sibling-source values.
